args.description: Pixel Heaven fantasy RPG building sprite. NATIVE crisp 1px PIXEL ART, NOT a flat front elevation. Camera slightly above at THREE-QUARTER angle: visible front wall AND right side wall AND top roof planes, convincing volumetric depth. Upper-left sunlight, brighter front plane, darker right wall, strong deep shadows under eaves, layered material shading, warm restrained palette. Orthographic camera with no lens distortion. An elegant fantasy temple with IVORY STONE, tall central tapered bell/spire tower topped by a golden SUN disk, teal pitched roof, two lower side wings and projecting entrance portico with stone columns. Clearly three-dimensional architectural massing with front and right side planes, layered roofs, buttresses, deep recessed arched doorway about 44px high and 24px wide. Distinct sacred silhouette, not a house, not a rectangular flat facade. Two narrow stone entrance steps, no surrounding courtyard slab. Single entire building isolated on true transparent background. Bottom-centred foundation/ground anchor, leave only 1px clearance at bottom. No separate isometric diamond of terrain, no lawn, no scenery, no text, no UI, no grid, no checkerboard. Keep whole silhouette inside native canvas. High quality richly detailed game sprite, clear architectural shape, no smooth rendering, no enlarged pixels.

postProcessing: Uniform integer translation of the complete static object to bottom-centred pivot. No scaling, redraw, per-pixel change or alpha loss.
